abstract: This report outlines the architecture, performance metrics, and evaluation results for the refactored automated report generation pipeline.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The LaTeX Report Generator automates document synthesis by combining dynamic data sources with rigorously formatted LaTeX document structures. This refactoring enhances maintainability, adds modular templating, and streamlines PDF compilation.

sections.content: The decoupled templating architecture provides significant improvements in speed and developer experience. Planned enhancements include integrated chart generation and interactive webhooks.
